EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Drinking coffee makes me feel so
sophisticated.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} It's the same feeling
I get drinking chocolate milk!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Me siento la mar de sofisticada
cuando bebo café.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} ¡También me
siento así cuando tomo chocolate!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Adoooro il caffè.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Ho letto
che i chicchi possono avere diversi
livelli di tostatura, lo sapevi?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Wenn ich Kaffee trinke, dann fühle
ich mich so erwachsen.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Genau wie
bei Kakao!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Kahve içince kendimi pek bir sofistike
hissediyorum.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Çikolatalı süt içerken
de aşağı yukarı aynı his geliyor!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I especially like coming here on
Fridays,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} when I can relax after a
long week with a warm drink.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Me gusta venir aquí los viernes para
relajarme tomando algo calentito
tras una larga semana.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'adore venir me détendre ici en
dégustant une boisson chaude, c'est
mon petit plaisir du vendredi !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mi piace venire qui di venerdì.
È il mio modo di dire adieu
alla settimana appena passata.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wenn ich eine lange Woche hatte,
gönne ich mir gerne freitags noch
ein Getränk zum Entspannen.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Özellikle cuma günleri buraya gelmeyi
seviyorum;{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} uzun bir haftanın ardından
sıcak bir içecekle dinlenmek
çok iyi geliyor.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I come here on Saturdays to get a
good cup of coffee and read my
favorite books.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Vengo los sábados para relajarme
leyendo mis libros favoritos con
una buena taza de café.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je viens ici presque tous les
samedis, pour profiter d'un bon
bouquin et d'un savoureux café !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il sabato vengo qui per bere un bel
caffè in compagnia di un buon libro.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich komme gerne samstags her,
trinke eine große Tasse Kaffee und
lese ein gutes Buch.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Cumartesileri güzel bir kahve içip
en sevdiğim kitapları okumak
için buraya geliyorum.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Sunday is my day to sit here with a
cup of coffee and my calendar for
the week.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Aprovecho los domingos para venir
aquí y preparar mi agenda para
la semana siguiente con un cafelito.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Je ne laisse jamais passer un
dimanche sans venir ici boire un
café et préparer ma semaine.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}La domenica vengo qui per bere
un ottimo caffè mentre organizzo
gli impegni della settimana seguente.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Sonntags gönne ich mir hier eine
gute Tasse Kaffee und plane die
kommende Woche.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Pazar günü, kahvemi ve haftalık
takvimimi alıp burada sakin sakin
oturduğum gündür.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I like tea too,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but sometimes a cup
of coffee helps me to wake up and
face the day ahead!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}A mí me gusta el té, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}pero a veces
un café me ayuda a estar despierta
y a empezar el día con energía.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Normalement, je préfère le thé,
mais un petit café de temps en
temps, ça vous fouette le sang !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mi piace anche il tè,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ma il caffè
mi dà la carica giusta per iniziare
la giornata!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich mag auch Tee, aber manchmal
hilft mir eine große Tasse Kaffee
einfach beim Aufwachen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Çayı da seviyorum,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ama bazen bir fincan
kahve uyanıp yeni güne hazır olmama
yardım ediyor!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I'm just enjoying a little afternoon
pick-me-up.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Oh,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} and I'm creating
new dessert recipes to go with it.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}He notado que se me ocurren
buenas ideas para postres mientras
tomo este café.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je m'offre un petit remontant...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Ce n'est pas interdit, que je sache !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}En plus, j'en profite pour imaginer
de nouvelles recettes de dessert
pour accompagner ce nectar !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Un caffè a quest'ora è proprio
ciò di cui ho bisogno per arrivare
energetica a fine giornata.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Fra l'altro, ho cominciato a fare
una lista di tutti i dessert che
starebbero bene con questo caffè...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Öğleden sonra biraz enerji topluyorum.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}
Aa,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} bir yandan da kahvenin yanına
yakışacak yeni tatlı
tarifleri düşünüyorum.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A warm drink in good company
helps melt away the stress of the
day.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I'll sleep well tonight!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Para aliviar el estrés que acumulo
durante el día, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}solo necesito una
bebida calentita y buena compañía.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Une boisson chaude en bonne
compagnie, et on peut dire bye-bye
à tous ses soucis !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bere qualcosa di caldo a quest'ora
mi aiuta a rilassarmi.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Stanotte dormirò come un ghiro!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ein warmes Getränk in angenehmer
Gesellschaft, und schon fällt der
ganze Stress von einem ab!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Güzel bir sohbet eşliğinde sıcak
bir içecek, günün bütün stresini eritip
götürüyor.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bu gece güzel uyurum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}The atmosphere here is so relaxing
at night.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's easy to get lost in a
book and forget what time it is!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}El ambiente de este local durante
la noche es muy relajante y me
ayuda a abrir mis chakras.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Il fait si bon lire ici...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Je ne compte
plus les soirées où j'ai oublié
l'heure, captivée par mon bouquin !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A quest'ora c'è l'atmosfera giusta
per perdersi fra le pagine
di un libro.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hier kann ich so gut entspannen,
dass ich schon öfter versehentlich
bis tief in die Nacht gelesen habe!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Geceleri buranın havası öyle huzurlu
oluyor ki.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kitaba dalıp saatin kaç
olduğunu unutmak işten bile değil!

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il caffè mi riempie di energia,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}ma troppo non mi fa dormire!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Siempre que puedo, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}me pido un
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}b{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lue mountain{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}No puedo resistirme
a su aroma.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ah, le {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Blue Mountain{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}... {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Son arôme
irrésistible vous emporte vers les
cimes enivrantes du vrai café...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Quando posso, ordino sempre
un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}caffè ristretto{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ha un sapore
molto più deciso degli altri!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich bestelle mir hier immer die
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Schonröstung{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Das Aroma ist
einfach fantastisch!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Fırsat bulduğumda hep {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}B{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lue Mountain
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}kahvesi söylerim.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kokusuna bayılıyorum.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I often order coffee made with
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mocha {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}beans.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} They have a richness
to them I really like.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yo suelo pedirme un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}moca{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} cuando
vengo aquí. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Creo que tiene un sabor
inigualable.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pour moi, le café, c'est du {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}moka{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} ou
rien.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Son arôme est si riche, et son
amertume si délicate !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}L'{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}espresso{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} è quello che preferisco.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ha un sapore cooosì ricco!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich finde, {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Mokka {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}ist einfach die
beste Kaffeesorte.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich mag das
leicht schokoladige Aroma.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sık sık {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mocha {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}çekirdeklerinden yapılan
kahve söylerim.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} O dolgun tadı
çok hoşuma gidiyor.

EN:
I like coffee made with {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kilimanjaro
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}beans.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It tastes so good,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} it brings a
big smile to my face!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Adoro el café {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}kilimanjaro{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Creo que
tiene como un carácter único que
lo distingue de los demás.
FR:
Je ne voudrais pas en faire une
montagne, mais le meilleur café
reste le {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kilimandjaro{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Die {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Doppelröstung {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}mag ich richtig
gerne.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Die erinnert mich immer an
meine Mama.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kilimanjaro {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}çekirdeklerinden yapılan
kahveyi seviyorum.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tadı öyle güzel
ki,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} yüzümde kocaman bir gülümseme beliriyor!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Cualquier hora es buena para gozar
con el café {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mezcla{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} que prepara
{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Fígaro{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ¿no crees, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
IT:
Il {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}caffè lungo {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}non ha eguali, per me.
Potrei berlo a ogni ora del giorno
e della notte!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich persönlich mag am liebsten die
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Hausmischung{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Da weiß man eben,
was man hat.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I like my coffee with {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lots {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}of milk. In
some places it's called café au lait.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A mí me encanta el café con {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mucha
leche{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡El calcio nunca sobra!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}J'aime mon café avec {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}une tonne{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} de
lait... {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}voire mon lait avec un nuage
de café, hi hi !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mi piace bere il caffè con {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}tanto{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
latte dentro. Adoooro il café au lait.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich mag meinen Kaffee mit {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}richtig
viel {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}Milch.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dann ist es fast mehr
Milch als Kaffee, hihi.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Kahvemi {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}bol {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}sütlü severim. Bazı yerlerde
buna café au lait deniyor.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I think coffee tastes best when you
put the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}regular {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}amount of milk in it.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}El café está más bueno si le pones
una cantidad {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}normal de leche{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Ni mucha ni poca!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Le lait dans le café, c'est comme
tout :{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} une question de proportion.
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Ni trop, ni pas assez{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, voilà le secret.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Kaffee ist am besten, wenn man
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}angemessen {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}Milch hineintut.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bence kahveye {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}normal {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}miktarda süt
koyunca tadı en güzel oluyor.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I like just a {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}little {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}milk in my coffee.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Not too much.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A mí me gusta el café con solo
un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}poquito de leche{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, aunque mucha
gente cree que queda muy amargo.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Un bon café ne se conçoit qu'avec
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}un soupçon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} de lait.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Attention :{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} « un
soupçon », pas « un louchon » !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Preferisco bere il caffè leggermente
macchiato. Solo {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}un goccio {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}di latte
e non di più.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich tu immer gern {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}einen Schuss
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}Milch in meinen Kaffee.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bloß nicht
zu viel!
TRANSLATION: {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Kahvemde sadece {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}biraz {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}süt severim.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Fazlası değil.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I take {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}no{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} milk in my coffee.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I like it
just the way it comes!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Pas{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} de lait pour moi.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Mélanger le
lait et le café, c'est gâcher deux
bonnes choses.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Alcuni miei amici mi chiamano
"Mademoiselle{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} niente latte{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}" perché
è così che mi piace bere il caffè.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich trinke meinen Kaffee {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ohne{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} Milch.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Schwarz und stark muss er sein!
TRANSLATION: {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Kahveme {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}hiç{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} süt koymam.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Geldiği hâliyle seviyorum!

EN:
I like my coffee extra sweet,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} so I
put {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}3 spoonfuls {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}of sugar in mine.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}A mí me gusta el café muy,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}muy dulce, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡con {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}tres azucarillos{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
FR:
Le goût du café n'exclut pas celui
de la douceur :{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} moi, je le prends
avec {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}trois cuillerées{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} de sucre !
IT:
Se nel caffè non ci sono almeno
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}tre cucchiaini {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}di zucchero, per me
non è caffè.
TRANSLATION:
Kahvemi epey tatlı severim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} bu yüzden
içine {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}3 kaşık {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}şeker koyarım.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I like exactly {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}2 spoonfuls {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}of sugar in
my coffee.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} No more and no less.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}A mí, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}el café me encanta con {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}dos
azucarillos{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Es la cantidad ideal.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je prends pile {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}deux cuillerées{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} de
sucre dans mon café.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Plus, c'est 
écœurant.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Moins, n'en parlons pas !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Nach einiger Recherche habe ich
entdeckt, dass {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}zwei Löffel {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}Zucker
im Kaffee genau richtig sind.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Kahvemde tam {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}2 kaşık {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}şeker severim.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Ne eksik ne fazla.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I only put {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}1 spoonful{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} of sugar in my
coffee.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's not too sweet that way.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Je n'ajoute qu'{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}une cuillerée {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}de sucre
dans mon café.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} C'est du café, après
tout, pas de la limonade !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Non mi piace bere il caffè se c'è
troppo zucchero. A me ne basta
solo {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}un cucchiaino{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mir reicht {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ein Löffel {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}Zucker in
meinem Kaffee.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} So ist er auch
nicht zu süß.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Kahveme yalnızca {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}1 kaşık{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} şeker koyarım.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Böylece fazla tatlı olmuyor.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}don't{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} normally use any sugar in my
coffee.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Instead,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I like eating dessert
while I drink it.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Yo no le pongo {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}nada{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} de azúcar a
mi café, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}porque suelo acompañarlo
con algún postre que ya es dulce.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Jamais{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} de sucre dans mon café.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} La
place du sucre, c'est dans le gâteau
que je déguste en même temps !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Il caffè mi piace amaro: {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}niente
zucchero{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} per me!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Normalde kahvemde şeker {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}kullanmam{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Onun
yerine,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} kahvemi içerken yanında tatlı
yemeyi seviyorum.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The coffee here smells great and
tastes strong without being bitter.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
It's delicious!
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}I bet you could make some amazing
coffee cake with it,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ce n'est pas du jus de chaussette
qu'on sert ici !{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} Quel délicieux
fumet !
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Une mousse de café tirée de ce
nectar, ça serait tout simplement
succulent, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Der Kaffee hier schmeckt stark und
aromatisch, genau, wie ich ihn mag.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Und er duftet auch immer so gut!
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Ich wette, man könnte sogar einen
superleckeren Wackelpudding mit
Kaffeegeschmack draus kochen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Buradaki kahvenin kokusu harika; tadı
güçlü ama acı değil.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Çok lezzetli!
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Bununla şahane bir kahveli kek yapılır
bence,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Serving good coffee takes freshly
roasted beans,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} a coffee grinder,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} and
attention to detail.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Someone who cares about me will
remember how I take my coffee!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Si sirves un café preparado con
cariño, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}estoy segura de que la gente
es capaz de notarlo.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Un caffè preparato con amour
ha tuuutto un altro sapore.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ein guter Kaffee schmeckt mild
und würzig zugleich. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Und man merkt,
wenn er mit Liebe gebrüht wurde!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}İyi kahve için taze kavrulmuş çekirdek,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
kahve değirmeni{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ve ayrıntılara özen
gerekir. {{TAG:0003:0004:}}Beni önemseyen biri, kahvemi
nasıl içtiğimi de hatırlar!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Creo que el ambiente tranquilo de
este local llega hasta lo más hondo
del espíritu.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Siempre me siento llena de paz
cuando estoy aquí.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ce café est un vrai poème !{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Et je
parle autant de la boisson que de
l'établissement !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Vengo volentieri qui! L'atmosfera
è semplicemente fantastique!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Jedes Mal, wenn ich hier eine Tasse

auf einmal ganz anders aus!
